newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering shares slip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering shares slip on profit-taking.

text.p: Engineering stocks slipped on Tuesday after the sector fell victim to profit-taking as interest rate worries and U.S. elections continued to put pressure on the London market, traders said.
Shares in Smiths Industries fell 12-1/2p to 792-1/2p, British Aerospace shed 20p to 1,136-1/2p and Siebe 14p to 944-1/2p.
"I think there's just been a bit of profit-taking after recent highs. The buyers aren't around today and it doesn't take much to bring the price back," said one senior trader.
British Aerospace hit an all-time high of 11.90 stg on October 21 while Smiths hit a record of 835p on October 23 and Siebe 10.17 stg on September 27.
